test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The doors and windows __will have painted__ by afternoon.
solution: The correct answer is '**will have been painted**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part in the given sentence is **grammatically incorrect.** • Here,** 'will have been painted'** should be used instead of** 'will have painted'.** • The given sentence is an example of **passive voice.** • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: *Subject (Objective Case) + will/shall + have + been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice)* • *Example: The site for our new factory **will have been finalized** by morning. (Passive Voice)* **Correct Sentence:__** *The doors and windows **will have been painted** by afternoon.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में रेखांकित भाग व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां 'will have painted' के बजाय 'will have been painted' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य passive voice का उदाहरण है। • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: *Subject (Objective Case) + will/shall + have + been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice)* • *Example: The site for our new factory **will have been finalized** by morning. (Passive Voice)* e2:T1051, The correct answer is** 'We yet'.**
